title: 2025's most downloaded game, Block Blast!, is going ad-free on Apple Arcade | TechCrunch
summary: The most downloaded mobile game last year has just landed on Apple’s subscription gaming service, Apple Arcade. Apple’s internal data indicates that Block Blast! was the most downloaded free iPhone game in 2025 .
